results.name: Flood in Ille-et-Vilaine, France
results.reason: The western part of France (Ille-et-Vilaine and Loire-Atlantique departments) is experiencing flooding, at levels not seen for over 40 years, since the 27 of January 2025. Flooding is reported along Vilaine River, a lull is expected from the 30 of January. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide initial rough estimation and flood extent emergency mapping.
results.activator: France|Centre Operationnel de Gestion Interministeriel de Crises (C.O.G.I.C)
